svg.title: Architecture: a question goes through the Gateway to the RAG API, which searches pgvector, keeps the conversation history in the same PostgreSQL, calls the models and sends its telemetry to the collector, then to Tempo, Loki and Prometheus, all read by Grafana. The ingest job reads the notes from the data lake, a host folder mounted read-only, and writes the pgvector index.
svg.text: folder of notes on the host
k3d CLUSTER · 1 control-plane node + 1 worker node, in Docker
